patch for the Steam version of "The Heiress" that adds R18 content.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

* Steam Version of "The Heiress"
http://store.steampowered.com/app/680320/The_Heiress/

* This patch adds 18+ content to the Steam version of "The Heiress"!
Upon extracting the contents, overwrite the files found in the
main folder of the Steam version of The Heiress with those same
named files in the extracted folder "The Heiress X-rated DATA"

[Note]
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
* This patch is for those that own the Steam version of "The Heiress".
* It cannot function as a stand alone product.
* It does not contain Japanese Language support.
* It is impossible to reverse the effects of applying this patch.
(Take care to make a backup of your game data beforehand.)
* Recommend purchase with DLsite account for updates.
